_about: Microsoft's permission matrix for the Foundry built-in roles, copied from the Foundry RBAC page (updated 2026-09-16). The page gives capabilities, not the role JSON. Reading keys is not a column here, but Microsoft's role JSON (built-in roles, AI + machine learning page) gives Foundry User Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/listkeys/action and Foundry Owner / Foundry Account Owner Microsoft.CognitiveServices/*. So azure_model.py evaluates those four roles from their JSON (foundry-*.json) and uses this matrix only for Foundry Agent Consumer, whose JSON isn't on that page; a capability that isn't a column is treated as NOT granted for it. Check any role with: az role definition list --name "Foundry Agent Consumer" --output json
